phase: Phase DD — Production-family additive tilt consuming Phase CC defensive_overlay_hint

improved_phasedd_hint_light.description: Tilt 5% of risk budget into BIL when defensive_overlay_hint == +1 AND production BIL exposure < 50%.

improved_phasedd_hint_moderate.description: Tilt 10% of risk budget into BIL when defensive_overlay_hint == +1 AND production BIL exposure < 50%.

improved_phasedd_hint_state_gated.description: Tilt 10% of risk budget into BIL ONLY in `neutral_deteriorating` weeks (the new state Phase CC created).

tilt_mechanic: On gate weeks: scale all non-BIL ETF weights by (1-delta); add freed share to BIL. On non-gate weeks: candidate weights == production weights exactly (full ablate-ability).

gates.improved_phasedd_hint_state_gated: refined_state == 'neutral_deteriorating' (the new state Phase CC created)

rationale: NO Phase DD candidate passes all selection gates. Best diagnostic candidate: improved_phasedd_hint_light; failure reason(s): drag>0.30pp; sharpe_imp<0.005; turnover>1.10x.
